title: about:blank Popup Farbling Bypass
description: Tests whether Brave's fingerprinting farbling applies inside a top-level about:blank popup from window.open(''). Such a popup commits in the renderer and never fires ReadyToCommitNavigation, the only hook that delivers Shields settings to a document, so farbling falls back to OFF and seven surfaces return real values. A control run shows the outcome depends on whether the opener or the popup's own realm reads first.
